executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $147.15 per resident day (42.7% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 5.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $630,293, 10.2% of the $6,178,225 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,017,352, $24.23 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $572,660 (56.3%), allocated fringe $64,341 (6.3%), non-wage costs $380,351 (37.4%). Raw food was $284,321 ($6.77 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $1,628.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $265,796, $6.33 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $211,951 (79.7%), allocated fringe $23,814 (9.0%), non-wage costs $30,031 (11.3%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $181,415, $4.32 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $16,130 (8.9%), allocated fringe $1,812 (1.0%), non-wage costs $163,473 (90.1%).
Missing data: cost years 2016, 2019, 2023 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2016 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; balance sheet does not add up). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2023 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; revenue lines do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
